items.item: `Sources/Plist XML/Plist.XML.Serializer.swift`: a whole real is written through `Int(number)`, which traps f
items.reason: Uses Int(exactly:) for the N.0 form and String(number) otherwise (e.g. 1e+300, which the parser reads back). Tests: 1e300 round-trips; 42 still writes 42.0.

items.item: `Sources/Plist XML/Plist.XML.Serializer.swift`: a null is written as an empty `<string>`, so an XML round
items.reason: Chose throwing: XML serialization now throws Plist.Error.unrepresentableInXML for null (anywhere in the tree) and for a date with no ISO 8601 form; formatDate also no longer traps on huge/NaN seconds (Int(exactly:) + overflow-checked epoch shift). README laws updated. Same commit as the real fix.

items.item: `Sources/Plist/Plist.Stream.swift`: when the source sequence of `Plist.ND.stream(_:)` throws, the stream
items.reason: On a source error the unfinished line is dropped, the stream yields .failure(.sourceSequenceFailure(...)) and ends. Test added; README law updated.

items.item: Remove or implement the inert located() and prepared() parse facades
items.reason: Issue has no checklist; took the 'remove' option it offers (implementing real offsets would need offset tracking through swift-xml and the binary parser). Removed Plist.Parse.located()/prepared(), Plist.Located, Plist.LocatedError, Plist.Prepared and the always-0 xmlOffset/binaryOffset. README had no mention left.

api_changes: Plist.serialize(format:pretty:), Plist.serializeXML(pretty:), Plist.Serializable.plistBytes(format:pretty:) and plistString(pretty:) now throws(Plist.Error)
Removed public API: Plist.Parse.located(), Plist.Parse.prepared(), Plist.Located, Plist.LocatedError, Plist.Prepared
dependents: none: no package under repos/ other than swift-plist depends on swift-plist or uses these APIs
notes: Existing XML serializer tests updated to try. Not built; swiftc -parse and swift format run on changed files.
